spans.s: गुंज m. 1. Humming; 2. a cluster of blossoms, a nosegay.

गुंजा f. 1. A small shrub of that name, bearing a red black berry, किं जातु गुंजाफलभूषणानां सुवर्णकारेण वनेचराणाम् Vikr.Ch.i.25; 2. a berry of this shrub used as a weight or an artificial weight called gunjā weighing 2-3/16 grains; 3. humming, low murmuring sound; 4. a kettle-drum, Bt.xiv.2; 5. a tavern; 6. reflection, meditation.
गुंज-कृत् m. a large black bee.
गुंजन n. Sounding low, humming.
गुंजिका f. A berry of the gunjā plant.
गुंजित n. Humming, murmuring, न गुंजितं तत्र जहार यन्मनः Bt.ii.29.
गुंठन n. 1. Concealing, covering; 2. smearing, e.g. अग्निहोत्रं त्रयो वेदास्त्रिदंडं भस्मगुंठनम् । बुद्धिपौरुषहीनानां जीविकेति बृहस्पतिः.
गुंठित a. (f. ता) 1. Surrounded, covered; 2. pounded, reduced to dust, (pp. of गुठ् q.v.).
गुंठित a. (f. ता) 1. Surrounded, covered; 2. pounded, reduced to dust, (pp. of गुठ् q.v.).
गुंडक m. 1. Dust, powder; 2. an oil-vessel; 3. a low pleasing tone.
गुंडिक m. Flour, meal, powder.
गुंडित a. (f. ता) 1. Pounded, ground; 2. covered with dust.
गुंडित a. (f. ता) 1. Pounded, ground; 2. covered with dust.
गुंदल m. The sound of a smal oblong drum.
गुंदाल m. The chātaka bird.
गुंदाल m. The chātaka bird.
गुंफ m. 1. Tying, stringing together; (hence) 2. composing; 3. a bracelet; 4. a whisker, a mustache.
गुंफना f. 1. Stringing together; 2. composing; 3. good composition (वाक्ये शब्दार्थयोः सम्यग्रचना गुंफना स्मृता).
गून a. (f. ना) Voided by stool (as ordure).
